what_worked: agent used polite Egyptian register: 'يا فندم' and 'عايز أتأكد' which is customer-friendly
agent consistently asked for clarification instead of assuming, avoiding a wrong-match recommendation

failures.what: Ignored the customer's explicit answer and repeated the same clarification question
failures.why_wrong: Customer replied 'بقول لادور بخور' but agent again asked 'ممكن توضح...' — this violates rule 7 (asking a question the customer already answered) and frustrates the buyer
failures.expected: A senior salesperson would accept the named perfume and respond (deny if not in catalogue) or offer alternatives; do not re-ask the exact same clarification.

failures.what: Failed to deny the named perfume and offer stocked alternatives in the same reply
failures.why_wrong: Store-configured handling requires: on first contact explicitly state 'مش عندنا لادور بخور' with an apology and immediately offer one or two stocked incense-capable perfumes by full name (e.g., Dior Homme Sport, Bleu de Chanel). Agent never did this.
failures.expected: Say plainly the perfume is not carried, apologize, echo customer's Arabic name, and offer 1–2 stocked alternatives with brief reasons.

failures.what: Did not retain customer's latest preference/name across turns
failures.why_wrong: The customer's freshest input 'لادور بخور' should override earlier ambiguity; agent failed to use it and kept asking the same question, scoring 0–2 under rule 5.
failures.expected: Use the latest explicit customer input and proceed accordingly (deny/offer alternatives or confirm stock).

failures.what: Repetitive robotic phrasing and no helpful content diminished trust
failures.why_wrong: Repeating the same sentence three times signals either system failure or inattentiveness; customers interpret this as low competence/trustworthiness per rule 10.
failures.expected: Respond naturally in Egyptian Arabic, avoid word-for-word repetition, and provide a useful next step.

failures.what: No recommendation or citation of supported store-configured facts
failures.why_wrong: The agent missed the opportunity to use allowed store facts (e.g., offering incense-capable stocked perfumes) and so gave nothing the customer can act on.
failures.expected: Offer Dior Homme Sport and/or Bleu de Chanel (both stocked) with short justification referencing their olibanum/incense base as allowed by the scenario.

salesperson_verdict: Not acceptable. This turn fails core requirements: the agent ignored the customer's explicit answer, repeated the same request for clarification, and did not deny the named perfume or offer stocked alternatives — a senior sales manager would require retraining and a scripted correct reply immediately.
